What brings you in?

Find tires for your vehicle.

An installed quote combines the tires and fitting. The total can vary with tire size, model, quantity, balancing, disposal and taxes. Your vehicle year, make and model are enough to start the conversation if you don’t know the size.

Call for a tire quote

Helpful details

  • Vehicle year, make and model
  • Tire size, if you know it
  • Winter, all-season or unsure

Bring in your seasonal set.

A wheel swap exchanges one set of mounted wheels for another. Loose tires need to be fitted to wheels and balanced, which is a different job. If each tire already has a metal wheel in the middle, your set is on-rim.

Call about a seasonal change

Helpful details

  • Vehicle year, make and model
  • Mounted on wheels, loose or unsure
  • Whether you also need an oil change

Plan your next service.

An oil-change estimate can vary with oil type, oil capacity and filter requirements. Your current mileage and last service record help identify what’s due. If you also need a seasonal swap, mention both when arranging your visit.

Call about maintenance

Helpful details

  • Vehicle and mileage
  • Service reminder or recent work
  • Any other service you want to combine

Tell us what you’re noticing.

Diagnosis checks what’s causing a symptom. A repair estimate covers the work proposed once the cause is understood. For example, a noise heard only while turning gives the shop a more useful starting point than “my car makes a noise.”

Call about a repair

Helpful details

  • Vehicle year, make and model
  • The symptom and when it started
  • Any warning lights or recent work

Before you visit

Answers to common questions about tire service and arranging a visit.

Where do I find my tire size?

Look on the tire sidewall for a code like 225/55R18. The driver’s door placard shows the original recommended size. If you’re unsure, call with your year, make and model.

What’s the difference between on-rim and off-rim?

On-rim tires are already mounted on their own wheels. Off-rim tires are loose and need to be mounted onto wheels. Tell the shop which set you have so it can quote the right job.

Can I ask about a tire change and oil change together?

Yes. Mention both when you call so the shop can advise on price and availability for the same visit.

Does a tire price include installation?

A per-tire price usually describes the tire itself. To compare quotes, check the quantity, mounting, balancing, any disposal fees and taxes. Ask for the installed total for your vehicle.

How do I arrange a visit?

Call 905-282-9869 to confirm hours, availability and whether to arrange a time before coming in.
